summary: Several independent choices under one question, in a fieldset with a legend. An optional parent checkbox selects or clears the whole group and shows a mixed state.
whenToUse: Users may pick zero, one or several options from a short visible list (up to about seven).
Use allValues plus <Checkbox parent /> for a Select all at the top of a long list.
whenNotToUse: Only one option can be picked: use RadioGroup.
More than about seven options or a searchable list: use Combobox with multiple selection.

dos.title: Ask the question in the legend
dos.text: The legend is read before each option, so it gives every label its context.

donts.title: A group without a legend
donts.text: Screen reader users hear "Light, checkbox" with no idea what it is for.

accessibility: Native fieldset and legend: the legend names the group; disabled on the fieldset disables every item.
description and error are linked to the fieldset with aria-describedby; the error carries an icon and text.
The parent checkbox is checked, unchecked or mixed (aria-checked) based on the children, driven by Base UI.
Each item keeps its own label and description, so items can be reached and understood one by one.
contentGuidelines: Legend as a short question or noun phrase: "Notify me about", "Platforms".
Options in a logical order (frequency, then alphabetical), parallel in grammar.
Errors say what to pick: "Pick at least one reviewer group."
